data_point: No fintech tooling: traditional bank and spreadsheets only
run_when: Job posts or pages describe the finance stack.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company uses no modern fintech tools at all, only a traditional bank and spreadsheets.
prompt.definition: This lowers the score but never disqualifies.
yes_when: Explicit text such as 'track expenses in Excel' with a traditional bank and no fintech tools
no_when: Any modern fintech tool is used
watch_out_for: Not finding any fintech tools is NOT proof; answer unknown

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

web_search.why: Based on absence; not finding fintech tools on the web proves nothing.
